steps.title: Attending the council
steps.text: Talk to Seren on the 1st floor (2nd floor[US]) of Burthorpe Castle.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Watch the cutscene or hit escape.
Continue the conversation.
Talk to Osman.

actions.text: Do you have anywhere we could plant the garden?

steps.text: Talk to Sir Amik Varze.

actions.text: Do you have a workforce to plant it?

steps.text: Talk to Azzanadra. Propose the plan.

actions.text: Do you have any seeds we could use?

steps.text: Talk to Vanescula Drakan. Propose the plan.

actions.text: Do you have anywhere we could plant the garden?

steps.text: Talk to Zarador. Propose the plan.

actions.text: Do you have anywhere we could plant the garden?

steps.text:
Kerapac will appear. Complete the dialogue.
  • If the dialogue containing Kerapac does not start, talk to Seren.

steps.title: The Needle
steps.text:
Talk to Kerapac next to the Needle.
  • It is located west of Piscatoris Fishing Colony (Phoenix Lair Teleport, fairy ring AKQ, Sixth-Age circuit teleports to Guthix memorial, or via memory strands within the currency pouch).
Close the temporal instability near the needle.
Close the temporal instability near the stream.
Close the temporal instability near the cart.
Close the temporal instability in the room upstairs.
Close the temporal instability.
Talk to Kerapac again.

Descend into the mysterious hole inside McGrubor's Wood.
  • ALS.
  • Seers' Village lodestone.
Investigate the coffin.
Read the letter from Charos.

steps.title: First key
steps.text: Step on the strange portal near the entrance to the Empty Throne Room in the Varrock Dig Site.
steps.warning: This section does not have tracking as of now.

steps.text: Solve every chest in the room. The helper guides each one: the combination-lock arrows (with the click count per dial), plus the 'Old recipe' NPC or lodestone 'Plaque' to read in those rooms. Once all chests are open and you open the completed WORD GRID, this advances automatically.

Rearrange the slide puzzle (the WORD GRID) to match the symbol blocks around the room. The helper numbers the cell to click for each move (1 = next) until it's solved. North (+Y) is the top of the grid.
Step on the exit portal to the west.
Find a way into Black Knight's fortress. Step onto the portal.

Solve every chest in the room. The helper guides each one: the combination-lock arrows (with the click count per dial), plus the 'Old recipe' NPC or lodestone 'Plaque' to read in those rooms. Once all chests are open and you open the completed WORD GRID, this advances automatically.

Rearrange the slide puzzle (the WORD GRID) to match the symbol blocks around the room. The helper numbers the cell to click for each move (1 = next) until it's solved. North (+Y) is the top of the grid.
Step on the exit portal to the west.

steps.title: Third key
steps.text: Climb the staircase in the Varrock Palace.
Step on the portal.

Solve every chest in the room. The helper guides each one: the combination-lock arrows (with the click count per dial), plus the 'Old recipe' NPC or lodestone 'Plaque' to read in those rooms. Once all chests are open and you open the completed WORD GRID, this advances automatically.

Rearrange the slide puzzle (the WORD GRID) to match the symbol blocks around the room. The helper numbers the cell to click for each move (1 = next) until it's solved. North (+Y) is the top of the grid.
Step on the exit portal to the west.

steps.title: The big reveal
steps.text: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library.

steps.title: The device
steps.text: Gear for combat. Deaths here are non-safe. Move to the next step when you're ready.
Talk to Kerapac at The Needle.

Kill the 5 Sliske clones and pick up the fragments.
  • Make sure lootshare is turned off.
Combine the fragments into Sliske's mask.
Walk to the bottom of the platform, wear the mask, and kill Guthix.
Harvest the five memories on Naragun.
Talk to Guthix near the empty fairy ring.

postconditions.text: with my death the Edicts fell

steps.text: Click each mutable anima once so both the green particles will end up on Kerapac.
Open the door at the end of the path.

Switch all the green mutable anima.
  • Use temporal rifts to teleport to the top floor.

Redirect the green mutable anima to Kerapac.
  • Harvest all three unrefined anima (red dots on the image) to unlock the three frozen anima. Make sure to finish the dialogue with each NPC.
  • Switch the green mutable anima according to the direction on the image. All of these can be clicked while standing on the main floor.
  • Disable bloom in graphics settings if it is difficult to see the direction the green mutable anima is facing.
steps.warning: Don't click on the mutable anima until directed to.

steps.text:
Watch the cutscene.
  • If cutscene doesn't start, talk to Kerapac.
Talk to Seren in Burthorpe.
